text:
Leah R.: AcmeHealth POC update — buyer sent a PO and a short note: they need Net45, a reference to their "vendor HSM" in the security appendix, and CFO to sign the order before funds release. Can we avoid a full MSA delay?

Tom C.: If we accept PO for provisioning only we should require the MSA countersign within 14 days. We'll provision minimal capacity on PO receipt.

Priya S.: Legal intake: we can't accept "vendor HSM" without approved vendor list. Proposed redline: replace with 'customer-managed keys via supported KMS or approved HSM vendors listed in Appendix A.' Also require 30-day breach notification and allow Redwood to suspend provisioning on unresolved security issues.

Leah R.: Finance: Net30 default. For POC under $40k we can do one-off Net45. Need billing email and PO # on invoice to auto-ingest.

Tom C.: Suggested DocuSign flow:
- Step 1: Acme CFO signs orderform envelope
- Step 2: Redwood Billing (ack invoice)
- Step 3: Redwood Legal countersign MSA
This keeps signing order simple.

Priya S.: I'll produce redline with the Appendix A approach and the countersign clause: 'Provisioning may commence on PO receipt for POC-only; full production rights subject to executed MSA.'

BillingBot: Please include this JSON snippet in the orderform metadata to help our AP system: {"billing_contact":"billing@acmehealth.com","po_number":"<PO_NUM>","net_terms":"45","currency":"USD","amount":"<AMOUNT>"}

Leah R.: Buyer asked about prorated credits mid-quarter. Answer: yes, standard prorata applies. Tom will confirm exact credit policy in email.

Tom C.: I'll draft DocuSign envelope and the follow-up to confirm prorate. Next steps: Priya posts redline (EOD), Finance approves Net45 one-off (EOD), Leah will upload PO scan here when received. :thumbsup:
